productionCallbacks: Existing nonisolated Sendable DailyHealthCallbacks factories; only registration type set, query limit and ordering changed. Async HealthKit descriptors add no SDK callback closures.

testOnlyCallbacks.reason: Nonisolated factory returns explicitly Sendable callback. Only immutable checked continuation is captured; mutually exclusive error or success resumes once. No UI or HealthKit store access occurs inside the callback.
